messages.subject: Project Lyra - completion mechanics and funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Maya, Eleanor,

We're targeting completion on Friday 12 June. Please find attached the completion funds flow. Summary:

- Subscription monies of £30,000,000 into our client account (Marisdale £25,000,005; Ravensworth £4,000,005; Aldridge £999,990)
- Company contribution to Marisdale's legal fees of £90,000 (incl. VAT)
- Our fees and Companies House filing fees
- Net £29,777,920 to the company on completion

Please confirm the payment references and that Marisdale will fund by 10am on completion day. Board and shareholder approvals are scheduled for the morning of the 12th.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
